title.en: An Act Providing for the Creation of an Additional Position of Municipal Judge for the City of Cavite, Amending for the Purpose Section Seventy-Four of Commonwealth Act Numbered Five Hundred Forty-Seven

text.en:
The first paragraph of section seventy-four of Commonwealth Act Numbered Five hundred forty-seven, otherwise known as the Charter of the City of Cavite, is amended to read as follows:
"
Regular, auxiliary and acting judges of municipal court.— There shall be a municipal court for the City of Cavite, for which two municipal judges and an auxiliary municipal judge shall be appointed."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 15, 1959.
